## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style game inspired by the TikTok “Beto chama a polícia” meme.

## Requirements
- Don’t ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Check screenshots using small JPEGs at viewport width no greater than 1280px.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game in Portuguese: an isometric backyard chase where Beto retrieves five stolen picanhas and reaches a phone to call the police.
- Used hand-drawn Canvas graphics without external assets; included keyboard and touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented title screen, gameplay loop, collectible meat, chasing chickens, noise meter, shout action, phone objective, win/lose states, sound toggle, and mobile controls in `index.html`.
- Started a local HTTP server and opened the game in Playwright; verified title and gameplay screenshots.

### Active
- Reviewing the latest gameplay rendering after adjusting isometric scene positioning in `index.html`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Capture and read a fresh JPEG screenshot after the latest positioning adjustment.
2. Check for any obvious visual or gameplay issues, then summarize the build and note assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Latest positioning edit changed `resize()` to `ox=W/2-(WORLD.w-WORLD.h)*scale*.285;oy=H*.58-(WORLD.w+WORLD.h)*scale*.1425;`; this adjustment has not yet been screenshot-verified.

- Beto collects five stolen picanhas, then reaches a phone to call the police; include keyboard and touch controls.
